model: NTRC Series temperature / humidity room sensor (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Greystone NTRC series network room sensors (temperature, optional RH, setpoint, fan switch, override, relay and digital input) with BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The NTRC is a Greystone wall sensor with native BACnet MS/TP. It reports temperature, optional RH and the fan speed switch as Analog Inputs; the local setpoint, its limits, offsets and display/override settings are Analog Values; Binary Values carry units, override status and a BMS-controlled relay, and a Binary Input reports the digital input.
notes: Points from the object table on page 1 of the setup guide.
RH, fan speed, setpoint, relay and DI objects only work when that option is fitted; otherwise they report NO_SENSOR / FAULT.
Some object notes in the guide call the setpoint mode and resolution objects BV6 and BV7; the object table lists them as BV 5 and BV 6.
Writing Temperature Units or Setpoint Mode resets Setpoint Minimum and Maximum to factory defaults, so set those first.
BV 3 becomes read-only when AV 7 is set to toggle or momentary.

source.title: Temperature/Humidity Sensor NTRC Series - Setup Guide BACnet Communication

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC in the menu, then read room temperature, RH, setpoint and override status. The BMS can switch the optional relay with BV 4 and must reset a latched override by writing 0 to BV 3.

minimum_points.name: Setpoint
minimum_points.why: Occupant setpoint from the front panel

setup: Default MS/TP MAC is 3 and default baud 9600, both set in the Setup menu.
Device instance defaults to 381003 (381000 + MAC); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
Lower Max_Master from 127 to the highest MAC on the segment.
gotchas: In latch mode (AV 7 = 0) the override stays on until the BMS writes 0 to BV 3.
Writing BV 1 or BV 5 resets the setpoint limits to factory defaults.
Poll every 5-10 s; faster polling congests the segment.
